findings.consequence: If a pallet stalls or jams at entry photo-eye PE-1002, the condition is never detected. Conveyor motor Y10 continues running continuously against the jam, causing mechanical wear, potential motor overload, or battery pack enclosure damage, violating CE-ST10-03.
findings.evidence: I/O list defines X11 (PE-1002 conveyor entry photo-eye), which the linter reports as never used. Parameter sheet defines jam_time as 5.0 s on timer T10. Cause-and-effect entry CE-ST10-03 and narrative §3 require that if PE-1002 is blocked for > 5.0 s while the conveyor is running, motor M-1001 (Y10) must stop and a jam alarm must be raised until reset. In the program, R2 resets M190 on fault reset (X1) and R3 reads M190 into fault master M199, but the rungs to execute timer T10 and latch M190 are completely missing.
findings.proposed_fix: Add the missing jam detection timer and latch rungs before R2: condition T10 on conveyor running (Y10) and entry eye blocked (X11) with preset K50 (5.0 s at 100 ms base): 'LD Y10', 'AND X11', 'OUT T10 K50'. Then set alarm latch M190 when T10 completes: 'LD T10', 'SET M190'.
findings.title: Missing Conveyor Entry Jam Detection Logic

findings.consequence: When a tripped motor thermal overload cools down, the conveyor automatically restarts without pressing Fault Reset (PB-0002 / X1). This presents an unexpected restart hazard to personnel inspecting or clearing the conveyor, violating narrative §4.8 and industrial machinery safety principles (IEC 60204-1).
findings.evidence: R1 drives motor overload alarm M191 with an unlatched OUT coil ('LDI X13', 'OUT M191'). When motor overload MOL-1001 trips, X13 goes low, setting M191 and M199 to de-energize Y10. However, once the thermal overload cools down and re-closes, X13 returns to 24 V (high), immediately resetting M191 to 0. R2 only resets M190 and does not latch or reset M191. Because R4 drives Y10 whenever Auto mode selector SS-0003 (X2) is ON and M199 is clear, the conveyor motor restarts automatically without operator intervention.
findings.proposed_fix: Latch the overload alarm on loss of healthy input X13 using 'LDI X13', 'SET M191'. Update reset rung R2 to clear M191 when Fault Reset pushbutton X1 is pressed and the overload is confirmed healthy: 'LD X1', 'AND X13', 'RST M191'.
findings.title: Conveyor Motor Overload Alarm Unlatched Causing Unexpected Auto-Restart

findings.consequence: If RQ-1005 is signaled when no pallet is at the stopper, the stopper will drop and allow an arriving pallet to bypass the test station without stopping or being tested. If RQ-1005 is triggered while the conveyor is stopped or in manual/fault mode, the stopper drops and re-extends after 2.0 s without releasing the pallet, potentially jamming against the pallet bottom.
findings.evidence: R6 triggers stopper release solenoid XY-1004 (Y11) unconditionally on the rising edge of release request RQ-1005 (X14) via 'LDP X14', 'SET Y11'. There are no interlocks checking whether the cell is in Auto mode (X2), whether a pallet is confirmed present at the stop (X10 / M100), or whether the station is free of faults (ANI M199).
findings.proposed_fix: Interlock R6 with Auto mode (X2), pallet at stop confirmed (X10), and no fault active (ANI M199): 'LDP X14', 'AND X2', 'AND X10', 'ANI M199', 'SET Y11'.
findings.title: Missing Interlocks on Stopper Release Solenoid

data.summary: Review of the ST10_CONVEYOR program identified three key defects against the narrative, cause-and-effect matrix, and parameter sheet. First, entry jam detection is entirely missing: X11 (PE-1002) is unreferenced, timer T10 is never driven, and jam alarm M190 is never set despite being reset in R2 and read in R3 (violating CE-ST10-03). Second, motor overload alarm M191 is driven by an unlatched OUT instruction rather than a latching coil, which permits the conveyor motor to restart unexpectedly upon thermal cooldown when Auto mode is active. Third, stopper release solenoid Y11 lacks operational interlocks for Auto mode (X2), pallet presence (X10), and cell healthy status (ANI M199), risking uninspected pallets passing through or stopper jamming.
